simpleschematics.config.title: Simple Schematics Settings
simpleschematics.config.import_nothing: Nothing there could be imported. It takes a zip, a .litematic or a .sschem.
simpleschematics.tip.import: Choose an exported zip, a .litematic or a .sschem to bring in. Dropping files onto this screen works too.
simpleschematics.tip.tab.library: Everything you have saved or dropped into the folder.
simpleschematics.tip.tab.placements: The builds you have put down in this world.
simpleschematics.tip.place: Puts a hologram on your crosshair. Point where you want it and right click to drop it. To build automatically, switch to Print with Ctrl and scroll, then press Enter.
simpleschematics.tip.place.none: Pick a schematic on the left first.
simpleschematics.tip.place.broken: This file could not be read, so there is nothing to place.
simpleschematics.tip.resource_list: Opens the full list of what this build needs.
simpleschematics.tip.resource_list.none: Pick a schematic on the left first.
simpleschematics.tip.resource_list.broke: This file could not be read, so its materials are unknown.
simpleschematics.tip.convert: Rewrites this Litematic as a native file, which loads faster.
simpleschematics.tip.convert.none: Pick a schematic on the left first.
simpleschematics.tip.convert.native: This is already a native file, so there is nothing to convert.
simpleschematics.tip.delete: Deletes the file from your schematics folder for good.
simpleschematics.tip.delete.none: Pick a schematic on the left first.
simpleschematics.tip.delete.placement: Removes this placement. The schematic file is left alone.
simpleschematics.tip.open_folder: Opens your schematics folder in a file browser.
simpleschematics.tip.reset: Clears everything you have ticked off or corrected by hand.
simpleschematics.tip.reset.none: Nothing has been ticked off or corrected yet.
simpleschematics.tip.count_placed: Blocks already standing correctly in the placement come off what is still needed. Only loaded chunks can be checked, so a distant build reads as untouched until you have been near it.
simpleschematics.tip.rebuild: Throws away the cached hologram geometry and builds it again.
simpleschematics.feedback.need_both_corn: Set Both Corners First, Left Click Then Right Click
simpleschematics.feedback.bank_needs_pla: Select a Placement First, Then the Chest Can Feed It
simpleschematics.gui.placements_hint: Right click a row to show or hide that build.
key.simpleschematics.toggle_box: Hold Menu: Show or Hide the Outline Box
simpleschematics.tip.live.mod: Switches the whole mod on or off and remembers the choice between worlds and game sessions. Hold Menu and press T to do it from in game.
simpleschematics.tip.live.mode: Scan captures a build, Build places its hologram, and Print builds it. Hold Ctrl and scroll to switch. In Print, right click with the tool or press Enter to start, and use the Clear key to pause.
simpleschematics.tip.live.holograms: Hides every hologram without switching the mod off. This choice is saved between worlds and game sessions. Hold Menu and press R.
simpleschematics.tip.live.resource_list: Shows the corner list of what this build still needs. Hold Menu and press O.
Select a placement, or pick up a schematic, so the list has something to follow.
simpleschematics.tip.live.highlight: Outlines the blocks that are wrong or in the way while you are in Build or Print mode. The menu and shortcut share one saved setting. Hold Menu and press H.
simpleschematics.tip.menu_key: On, nothing else bound to this key responds to it, which is what stops Menu and T also opening chat. Off, a minimap on the same key works again, but the chords stop being reliable, so rebind the menu key under Controls as well.
simpleschematics.tip.shader_pack: Iris and Oculus replace the level render and ignore this mod's own shader, which leaves the holograms invisible. Auto uses a plain render type whenever a pack is loaded, at the cost of the near fade and the distance fade.
simpleschematics.tip.shader_pack.none: No shader mod is installed, so this changes nothing. It matters once Iris or Oculus is running a pack, because they ignore this mod's own shader and the holograms would otherwise be invisible.

simpleschematics.feedback.build_list_nee: The Build List Needs a Schematic to Follow
simpleschematics.build_list.title: Still to Place
simpleschematics.tip.live.build_list: Lists what is still to place for the build you have selected, cut to the layer you are looking at. Hold Menu and press N.
simpleschematics.tip.live.build_list.non: Select a placement, or pick up a schematic, so the list has something to follow.
simpleschematics.tip.build_list: Says what is still to place for the layer you are looking at. Size, width, panel darkness and the stack breakdown follow the resource list settings.
simpleschematics.tip.build_list.anchor: Sending both lists to the same corner stacks them rather than drawing one over the other.
simpleschematics.tip.breathe: Pulses the hologram opacity slowly, so the ghosts stand out from the real blocks around them.
simpleschematics.feedback.override_match: That Block Already Matches the Schematic
simpleschematics.feedback.override_needs: Point at a Block Inside a Placement
simpleschematics.tip.print.source: Choose inventory, linked chests, or both. Both uses inventory first. Linked chests must be nearby and reachable; items are moved into your inventory before placement. Hold Shift and right click a chest with the tool to link it to the selected placement.
simpleschematics.tip.print.delay: Twenty ticks is one second. The default of four ticks places up to five blocks each second in Survival. The server may accept blocks more slowly.
simpleschematics.tip.print.sounds: Play each block's placement sound while printing. Sounds sent separately by the server may still be heard.
simpleschematics.tip.print.survival: Remind you to check the rules before automated building in Survival. Most servers ban this behaviour, so only continue where it is allowed.
simpleschematics.tip.print.missing: Ask before printing when materials are missing. Choosing Yes builds as much as possible. With this warning off, printing uses the available materials straight away.
simpleschematics.tip.print.replace: Operators can replace blocks in the way when this is on. Other players must clear obstructing blocks by hand. Off by default to protect existing builds.
simpleschematics.tip.print.entities: Include saved entities in Creative when the server allows commands. Survival never creates entities. Creative without commands can place reachable blocks but cannot restore entities or saved data.
simpleschematics.tip.print.contents: Restore saved container contents in Creative when the server allows commands. Survival always leaves new containers empty. Existing matching containers are left alone.
simpleschematics.tip.print.start: Start or continue building this placement. Creative operators paste it in place; Survival uses available materials and places reachable blocks. The next screens check the build and explain any warnings.
simpleschematics.tip.print.none: Select a placement in the list first.
simpleschematics.tip.print.broken: This placement's schematic could not be read. Restore the file or choose another placement.
simpleschematics.tip.print.mode: Printing is available in Creative and Survival modes.
simpleschematics.print.title: Print Schematic
simpleschematics.print.mode: Switch to Creative or Survival to print a schematic.
simpleschematics.print.select: Select a placement with a readable schematic in the library first.
simpleschematics.print.inventory_busy: Close the container and put down any item held by the cursor before printing.
simpleschematics.print.changed_obstructi: A block is now in the way at %s. Clear it and print again to continue.
simpleschematics.print.linked_obstructio: A linked container is in the way at %s. Move it outside the build before printing.
simpleschematics.print.bounds: The build extends beyond the world border or build height at %s. Move the placement inside the world limits.
simpleschematics.print.unloaded: %s blocks are in unloaded chunks. Move closer or increase your view distance, then print again.
simpleschematics.print.replacement_disab: %s blocks need replacing. Clear them first, or enable Allow Operators to Replace Blocks in Print settings.
simpleschematics.print.obstructions: %s blocks need replacing. Clear them by hand before printing; only operators can replace existing blocks automatically.
simpleschematics.print.continue: This build is already in progress: %s block positions are complete and %s still need work. Continue building from its current state?
simpleschematics.print.survival_warning: Automated building is bannable on most servers. Double-check the server rules before proceeding. Continue only if automated building is allowed here?
simpleschematics.print.creative_no_op: Instant pasting requires operator permission. Without it, Print can place reachable blocks using normal Creative placement. Saved entities, container contents and other block data cannot be restored. Continue?
simpleschematics.print.replace_warning: %s existing blocks will be replaced. This may destroy their contents. Continue only if you want these blocks removed?
simpleschematics.print.missing_warning: This build still needs %s more items than the selected material sources currently show. Choose Yes to build as much as possible, then add materials and print again to continue. Proceed?
simpleschematics.print.banks_warning: Chest totals are cached estimates. Print will open reachable linked containers and move needed stacks into your inventory. Linked Chests mode leaves your original supplies unused. If the estimates are stale, Yes builds as much as the available materials allow. Continue?
simpleschematics.print.survival_data: Saved entities, container contents and other block entity data can only be restored in Creative. Survival will build the blocks and ignore this saved data. Continue?
simpleschematics.print.waiting: %s blocks remain. Move closer, bring materials or provide missing support blocks.
simpleschematics.print.paused: Printing Paused; Print Again to Continue
simpleschematics.print.partial: Placed %s blocks; %s remain. Add materials, move closer or fix support blocks, then print again to continue.
simpleschematics.print.creative_partial: Placed %s blocks; %s saved data or entity entries were omitted. Review the schematic and server restrictions before continuing.
simpleschematics.print.server_timeout: The server did not confirm the placement. Printing paused; check your connection and server permissions before continuing.
